answer: `isPrime` is the slowest function in `scripts/slow.mjs`, taking about 442ms of the roughly 524ms profile (84%). It is called from `countPrimes`, and its trial-division loop runs up to `n` iterations for every candidate instead of stopping at the square root. `dedupe` is a distant second at about 60ms (11.5%), from its quadratic `includes` check. I did not change any files.
